$comment: How the Readings score the genius tree (docs/genius-tree.md). Every number is a designer's knob. The rite scores each base by its calls: the weight of each line (Seed, blood, Shape) times what the base says of the character's own; a home's lean (data/genius-homes.json) multiplies it for the second and third offers, and each later offer counts for sameClass of its score for every base of the same class already offered, so the bowl shows three kinds of thing. A refinement scores each child of the form the genius is by its leans: for each line and key it leans on, the line's weight times its emphasis (how much play there has been on that line, against its reference) times the lean times the share of that key in the play, over the sum of its leans. The pattern line counts fires against patternFires; bonds and sworn are yes or no.

words.$comment: How the page and the Reading say a line of the Tally in plain words: what play leads to a form ('fighting close, parrying'). rite: what the first Reading read.

pattern.sworn: a Pattern sworn at the hearth
